shortDescription: Real stacked z-levels for 1.6: sky level above, solid rock basement below, fully simulated linked maps with live see-through air, cross-level work/hauling/power/pipes/climate, one-colony UI.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: one sky level above, the surface, one basement below. Every level is a real simulated map. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky level with a live view of the surface below; (2) performance via caching, event-driven work, and zero recurring cost when idle.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony only. DBH and VEF PipeSystem as soft compat.
- Soft-compat hard rule: foreign types ONLY as locals inside method bodies of gated classes — never in method signatures, fields, properties, or attributes. Assembly-wide attribute scans (debug menu setup) resolve signature types even for never-called methods.
- Cap: 3 levels per column. Upper-level rules match Z-Levels beta semantics.
- Basement: solid mineable rock, fogged, thick-roofed, stable 12C underground; vanilla collapse rules intact.
- Robustness: ABGuard kill switches (ui, levelGen, rendering, movement, logistics, roofSync, weather, power, pipes, climate); fail open everywhere.
- All player-facing text: vanilla sentence case, ASCII only, no long dashes.

## How it works (T0-T4 and T6 verified in-game 2026-07-19)
- Core: LevelComp registry on aligned pocket maps; stairs pairs generate levels; loss-proof StairTransfer; PageUp/PageDown level view; links severed cleanly on map removal.
- Sky mountains: contracted mass, ledge ring, lit face rows, fogged core, guaranteed mining reveal.
- See-below renderer: whitelisted content layers only (incl. water depth via SectionLayer_Watergen); air-cells light mask; live dynamic things below; far clip 70; below-map pawn silhouettes suppressed during the offset pass.
- Ceiling hints: SectionLayer_ABCeiling on the surface draws a faint panel texture on cells under BUILT sky floors. Keys on the Roofs mesh flag + cross-map dirty + load nudge. Settings toggle showCeilingHint.
- Live sync via MapEvents; weather link every 150 ticks; pocket levels' own WeatherDecider suppressed (prefix, fails open) — the surface is the sole weather driver.
- Bomb rooftop punch: Bomb damage >= 40 on AB_RoofSurface removes the constructed roof below via the normal roof cascade. Natural roofs immune by construction.
- Cross-level work, idle return, drafted gizmos; hauling (storage + construction demand + right-click); needs (bed redirect).
- Power: stairwells are cross-level power links (paired hidden 1000 Wd buffers, 10-tick equalization, bank forwarding, no storage presentation). Multi-megawatt effective throughput.
- Pipes: DBH water and VEF PipeSystem resources equalize through stairwells; both bridges are single clean-signature BridgePair methods per the soft-compat rule. DBH sewage needs per-level handling.
- Climate: sky outdoor/seasonal temperatures mirror the surface live; stairwells exchange heat vent-style (25 units per degree per 250 ticks, clamped, toggleable).

## Documented accepted limitations (field manual material)
- Floating rim/ledge rock if the supporting natural roof below is mined out (rare); left as-is by decision.
- Sky-level projectiles crossing open air pick up the below-mask dim for a few frames (cosmetic; clean fix needs a subcamera composite).
- Threat policy: raids target the surface; pocket levels raid-free by vanilla semantics; basement does not attract infestations. Opt-ins slated for T8.

## Profiling audit (clean through T6)
Per-tick fixed: stairs Normal tick + per-map modulo checks + DrawPos idle branch. Event-driven: roof/terrain/spawn handlers, ceiling-hint regen on roof-flag dirties, bomb postfix on Bomb explosions only. Periodic: 10t power, 150t weather, 204t resources, 250t climate + pipes, 600t haul caches. Per-frame only while viewing the sky level.

## Tranche plan
- T0-T4, T6 DONE and verified in-game (2026-07-19, run #73).
- ACTIVE: T7 logistics depth + T10 QoL/UI (user directive; T5 publishing prep stays parked until after).
- Backlog: T8 threat opt-ins, T9 pipe depth, T11 world integration (see _dev ROADMAP.md).

## Status
Starting T7 (logistics depth) then T10 (QoL/UI), sequenced with a verification run between tranches. Two design questions pending with the user: elevator scope (T10 #2) and animal crossing policy (T7 #6).
